title: feat(service-print): print a record on any print page of its object, not only its default record page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XN1ALtdy52CrgiAPP8xVRiT)_

Fixes #26583

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

**No authorable key is added or changed** (no `packages/spec/**` in the diff; the request body already carries `page`), so per triage 6440154784 this card grades **p2**.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：服务端打印（`@objectstack/service-print`）现在可以把记录打印在该对象的**任意一个声明了 `print` 的记录页**上，不再只限默认记录页。默认记录页照旧走记录路由；其它打印页走控制台已发布的具名记录页路由 `…/record/ID/page/PAGE`。
- **为什么改**：以前要打印报价，就得把报价的日常记录页改成打印文档，销售每天都会失去状态路径、亮点区、详情/相关标签页和动态（objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2312 因此停着）。维护者裁决 A（6439306670）。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只放宽一条服务端检查、换一个 URL；页面不是该对象的记录页、或没声明 `print` 仍然 400 拒绝，未知页名仍然 404。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-print/src/print-service.ts`（`refuseUnlessPrintPage`、新的 `isRecordPageOf` 与 `printPageUrl`）；`packages/qa/dogfood/test/print-service-named-page.dogfood.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-print exec vitest run src/print-service.test.ts`，预期 50/50 通过，其中「not the default record page prints on the console’s named record-page route」一条。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`PrintService.printRecordToFile` (and so `POST /api/v1/print/records`), step ③ "the page":

- **Accepted:** any page that is a record page of the request's object and declares `print`. The third refusal on `main`, "is not the default record page of OBJECT (isDefault: true)", is gone.
- **The URL:** the object's default record page still renders on the console's record route, `CONSOLE/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID`. Any other print page renders on the console's named record-page route, `CONSOLE/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID/page/PAGE` (`RECORD_NAMED_PAGE_ROUTE`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:280`), every segment encoded on its own (`printPageUrl`).
- **Two loud refusals remain**, both `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400, before anything is read, minted or launched: the page is not a record page of the object, or it declares no `print`. An unknown page name stays `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` / 404.

**The predicate both sides use.** The console's named route renders the named page only when `isRecordPageOf(named, objectName)` holds (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:787–792`), and that function is `p.type === 'record' && p.object === objectName` (`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/usePageAssignment.ts:94–98`); any other name gets a not-found state, never a fallback. The server's check is now that exact reading (`isRecordPageOf` in `print-service.ts`, docblock names the console's), so the server prints exactly the set the console draws, no wider. It is a local copy because `service-print` cannot import `@object-ui/react`, and adding a shared reading to `@objectstack/spec` is outside this lane.

`content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx`: the "A print page that is not the default is refused" sentence is rewritten to say a record prints on any print page of its object (and on which route), the example page drops `isDefault: true`, and the refusals table row reads "not a record page of the object (`type: 'record'`, that `object`), or declares no `print`". The repo carries no translation of this page (`find content -name 'print-pages*'` → the en file only).

Changeset: `@objectstack/service-print` patch, both declaration lines line-initial.

## Why

To print a quote, an app had to make the quote's everyday record page its printed document, and reps lost the status path, highlights, Details/Related tabs and the activity feed on every quote (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2312, REQ-0008). The console's named record-page route (objectui#12715) already draws a named record page for a record and refuses any other name; only the server half refused. Ruling 6439306670, letter A.

## Tests

Red first on `main` (`c739de755c`), then green at head:

| Suite | On `main` | At head |
|---|---|---|
| `service-print` `src/print-service.test.ts` (tests only changed) | 3 failed / 47 passed: the named-route accept, the encoded named URL, the typeless default page | 50 / 50 |
| dogfood `print-service-named-page.dogfood.test.ts` + `print-service-archive.dogfood.test.ts` (stand-in browser, real showcase boot) | named-page leg red: "The page 'showcase_project_brief' is not the default record page of 'showcase_project' (isDefault: true)…" | 13 / 13 |
| dogfood `print-service-render.dogfood.test.ts` (real console bundle + real Chromium, both placements, `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=on`, see Acceptance notes) | the 2 named-page legs red with the same refusal; the other 6 green | 8 / 8 |

The `main` legs ran with `print-service.ts` restored from `c739de755c` (the dogfood imports the service from `src/`), restored afterwards by `git checkout HEAD --` and proved by `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob hash matching HEAD.

Unit rows (`print-service.test.ts`):
- `'a print page that is not the default record page'` moved from the refusal table to an accept: it renders `…/record/inv_1/page/invoice_document` and archives `invoice_document-inv_1.pdf`.
- The default page still renders the plain record route (pinned), and a name carrying `/` and a record id carrying a space are encoded as one segment each.
- Refusal rows kept or added: a page of another object, a page with no `print` (default and non-default), a default `type: 'home'` page, a non-default `type: 'app'` print page, and a page with no `type` (default and non-default).

Dogfood (new `print-service-named-page.dogfood.test.ts`, fixture in `print-named-page.fixture.ts`): `showcase_project` keeps its working default record page `showcase_project_detail` (slotted, no `print`); a project brief that declares `print` is saved beside it through the metadata save door (`protocol.saveMetaItem`). A project prints on the brief through the named route and is archived on the project as the requester; the working page (no `print`) and the brief asked for an invoice (another object) are refused 400 with nothing minted.

**What the real render put on paper.** A one-off copy of the render leg wrote both PDFs out; `pdftotext -layout`:
- the brief, printed on the named route: `Project brief` / `Brief` / `PROJECT NAME  STATUS` / `Compliance Audit  On Hold` / `START DATE  END DATE` / `Oct 12  Nov 26` / `1/1`, so the console drew the brief for that project, not a not-found state and not the default page;
- the invoice, on the record route: `ObjectStack Showcase Ltd · 示例有限公司` / `Invoice` / `INV-RENDER-local  Draft` …, unchanged.

Other local runs at head: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-print test` 8 files / 114 tests passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-print typecheck` exit 0 (its `include` is `src`, so the test files are compiled); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` exit 0; eslint `--no-inline-config` on the touched service-print and dogfood files exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Clause-②` measured on the diff.** The accept set widens: a request naming a non-default print page, refused 400 on `main`, now prints. One shape moves the other way, stated rather than hidden: a page body in the registry with **no `type` at all** that is the default record page and declares `print` was accepted on `main` (the old check read `defaultRecordPageObject`, which treats an absent `type` as `'record'`) and is now refused 400, because the console's `isRecordPageOf` reads `type` exactly. On `main` such a print did not print that page: the console's record route filters with the same `isRecordPageOf`, so it drew the synthesized default page instead. No authoring door produces that body (`defineStack` parses with `PageSchema`'s declared default, and the metadata save door and stored-row hydration fill it, #20101 `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault`); only a plugin calling `registry.registerItem` with a raw body can. I declared `yes (widening)`; if the seat reads that one shape as a narrowing, the arm is the seat's to change.
- **The render dogfood is red on a default environment, at `main` too, for a reason outside this card.** Without `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED`, the console's policy is `script-src 'self' 'nonce-…' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'` (no `'unsafe-eval'`, `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts:851–852`, off unless set), and the print driver's `page.waitForFunction(PRINT_READY_PREDICATE, …)` (`chromium-driver.ts:303`) passes a string, which Chromium refuses to evaluate: all 6 legs failed, including the untouched invoice leg, with `The print engine failed at the local executable …: page.waitForFunction: EvalError: Evaluating a string as JavaScript violates the following Content Security Policy directive …`. CI skips this file (no console bundle), so `main` has not seen it. Reported to the seat as a defect for its own card; the readings above were taken with `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=on`.
- `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/invoice-document.page.ts:12–14` still says the invoice's print page is its default record page "because the console renders a record on its default record page, so that is the page a record prints on". That reason is no longer the only option after this PR (the page may stay the default by choice). It is a comment in a private package, outside the claim's file surface: left for the seat.
